rationale: Adds a user-facing SVG current-view download alongside the existing architectural PDF, including independent device/layer choices and transparent/current/custom backgrounds. No configuration migration or PDF geometry change.

summary.ru: Скачивание SVG текущего вида плана с выбором устройств и фона в общем диалоге печати.
summary.en: Download the current plan View as SVG with device and background choices in the shared print dialog.
